scope: For cellular proteomic analysis, 200 µL of cold lysis buffer (Tris-buffered saline containing 1% NP-40 and 2% cOmpleteTM protease inhibitor cocktail (Merck, Darmstadt, Germany/Roche, Basel, Switzerland)) were added to one snap-frozen wedge of each transwell chamber, and the cells were detached on ice using a cell pestle

In parallel to RNA isolation, we also isolated the protein fraction from the cells.
